observation: Fresh main binds closure.runId to the latest completed cycle, but the supervisor also always emits closure.at and closure.assessment when a cycle completes. Durable reads still accepted a completed mission whose closure timestamp was blank or whose assessment field was removed.
changes: Require completed missions (cycle > 0) to preserve a non-empty closure timestamp and the presence of closure assessment in addition to the existing latest-cycle runId binding.
Publish that completed-cycle closure envelope in Autonomous Mission v0.1 while keeping cycle-0 null closure compatibility.
Keep assessment payload semantics unconstrained and add focused durable-tamper coverage.

verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: cycle-0 null closure stays valid; completed closures require latest-cycle runId, non-empty at, and an assessment field.
